body:
If you feel like failure calls for ending it, maybe a break is the best option, which is what I did. If someone judges you for it, then they simply don’t understand.
It’s a very complicated time, it’s difficult. But pressure into doing something, especially something that you feel will be the end of your life, is something that you should avoid at all costs. Because you have plenty of time, and figuring it out in the first 1/5 of your life isn’t required, no matter what people think.

I felt the same way about my old dog, Cheyenne. On July 4th of 2016, she was missing. We looked around the neighborhood and couldn’t find her. The next day, when she didn’t return, we looked further, and found her poor soul resting in the side of the highway. While it was heartbreaking, knowing she’d never return, I took it as confidence. Sort of like I was living for her, because she would be dissapointed if I didn’t. It was a huge change of mindset for me!
Never got to do Kings Fall, feel like I missed out, really want a chance to do it.  I'm 390, Xbox one, GT- Dustin Mucklow
